transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well, I’m here because... honestly, I need someone to take what's happening seriously. For months now, the property manager and certain people in my building have been trying to pressure me out of my apartment. 

It's a very orchestrated effort. They've been using misdelivered mail, making these perfectly timed noises in the walls, and... well, having neighbors drop these little comments when I walk by. The management tries to show me paperwork or give me standard explanations to cover it up, but I look at patterns for a living. No amount of their paperwork or excuses changes the pattern I can clearly see them executing against me.
Do you ever hear voices when no one is actually there?

No, I don't hear voices. I'm not crazy. I just hear the actual noises they make—the tapping on the walls, the footsteps above me when they know I'm trying to sleep. It's real people doing real things to harass me, not something I'm imagining in my head.
Have you had a period where you felt unusually high, energized, or unstoppable for days at a time?

No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I'm not unusually energized or feeling unstoppable. Honestly, I'm just exhausted. Dealing with this constant harassment... it takes a toll. I go to work, I come home, and I have to stay alert because I know they're trying to push me out. There's no high energy here, just a lot of stress from what they're doing to me.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day?

No, I wouldn't say depressed. I mean... I don't feel sad or hopeless all day, if that's what you're asking. I'm definitely frustrated, and like I said, exhausted by the whole situation at my building. Anyone would be. But I'm not depressed. I still have things I want to do, I just... I just want to be left alone so I can live my life in peace.
Do people ever tell you that your speech or thoughts are hard to follow or seem disorganized?

No, nobody has ever said that to me. I communicate very clearly. My thoughts aren't disorganized at all. I mean, when I'm not dealing with the whole situation at the apartment, I still manage all my own finances, I cook for myself, I keep all my appointments... I can even sit down and discuss my consulting work or my painting in a completely organized, logical way. There's nothing wrong with my thinking. I'm just dealing with a very specific problem that other people refuse to see.
Before all of this started, had you been diagnosed with any brain or neurological illness?

No, nothing like that. I've never had any brain issues or neurological problems. I've always been perfectly healthy in that regard. My mind is as sharp as it's ever been. Like I said, the only issue I'm dealing with is what's happening at my building.
How long has this been happening?
It's been going on for about eleven months now. It started... well, shortly after I moved into the new apartment.
Have you ever seen things that other people could not see?

No, I haven't. I don't see things that aren't there, if that's what you mean. I only see what is actually happening in reality. There's no... visions or anything like that. I just see exactly what anyone else would see if they were actually paying attention.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?

No, I wouldn't say that. I still enjoy the same things I always have. I mean, I still like reading, watching the news, having a good cup of coffee... none of that has changed. I just don't have as much time to focus on them right now because I have to stay vigilant about what's going on in my building. But the interest is still there.
Aside from the situation with your building, have you had trouble keeping up with your work the way you used to?

Well, yes, I suppose I have. I’ve actually had to pull back from several of my consulting jobs recently. I just... I end up spending so much of my week having to follow up with the neighbors, the management offices, and the building staff about what's going on. It takes up a lot of time. So instead of just settling into my normal work, or even my usual painting routine, I'm dealing with all of that. It definitely has cut into my schedule.
Has anything happened that made you believe these people can control your thoughts or put thoughts into your mind?

No, absolutely not. I mean, my thoughts are entirely my own. I don't believe anyone can put thoughts into my mind... that sounds like science fiction. What they're doing is very real, very physical—coordinating things in the building, watching what I do—but they aren't inside my head. I am completely in control of my own mind.
When you are alone, do you ever hear people talking about you?

No, I don't hear anything like that. I mean, if I'm alone in my apartment, it's quiet. Obviously, I hear them if they are physically out in the hallway talking, but I don't just... hear voices out of thin air, if that's what you're asking. I'm not imagining things.
Other than your neighbors and building management trying to push you out, have you had any other unusual beliefs that others say are not true?

No, not at all. I mean, aside from what we've been discussing about the building, everything else in my life is completely normal. No one has ever pointed out anything else... I don't have any other strange ideas, if that's what you mean. It's just this one very real situation with the management and the neighbors. That's the only issue.
